channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde announces her resignation from the position before her term ends.
item.description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde announced her resignation, effective February 7, 2027, triggering an immediate search for her successor. While all outlets confirm the timeline, Western coverage frames the move as a pragmatic shift toward broader fiscal policy and personal mandate freedom. Conversely, Eastern reports interpret her departure as a deliberate move to abandon institutional neutrality in favor of active political engagement.
